propositions: rebar comment accepts flag-looking tokens (e.g. --body-file, --body) as the positional body argument, storing the flag name itself as the comment and silently discarding the intended content while exiting 0

the same footgun occurs in multiple positional-body commands (create, edit, session-log, tag, untag, archive, set-verify-commands) and defeats the documented practice of writing durable records to the ticket store
a body argument beginning with - must be rejected with non-zero exit and instructive error message unless explicitly escaped via -- separator
the -- escape hatch must allow bodies that legitimately start with - to be written and must be tested across comment and tag paths
surplus positional arguments after a flag-like token are silently dropped by args[:min_args] slicing, creating a second silent-loss path even if the flag rejection alone were fixed
